d: The Garfield gang is in Hawaii with a 1957 Chevy.
Jon is harassed by a magazine salesman. An escaped saber tooth tiger switches identities with Garfield.
Jon buys a new TV from Madam Murray. Wade suggests the Roy Rooster Fan Club be changed to the Wade Duck fan club.

st: Skyway Robbery/The Bunny Rabbits Coming/Close Encounters of the Garfield Kind
d: Jon decides to fly Swindler Airlines to Miami./A mysterious message arrives./A friendly alien lands in Jon's backyard.
Jon, Garfield and Odie spend the night in a spooky hotel./Orson tries to convince Wade that fortune cookies aren't accurate./On a hot summer day, Garfield brings out the Christmas decorations.
Odie finds a genie and is granted his wish to fly. A witch decides Jon will be her husband.
Garfield demonstrates the importance of sound effects. The Wolf convinces the crew aliens have landed.

st: Cabin Fever/U.S. Acres: Return of Power Pig/Fair Exchange
d: Garfield and Odie are snowbound in a cabin with no food./A monster circulates around the farm, Orson dons his "Power Pig" togs./Garfield dreams he changes places with Jon.

st: Magic Mutt/U.S. Acres: Short Story/Monday Misery
d: When Jon goes to an all-night magic shop./Booker is irritated by his height./Garfield attempts to defeat the evil day, Monday.
Two mice critics review a documentary./Wade is mistakenly hypnotized to turn into a monster./The network insists that Nermal tell a story.
Garfield sits on Jon’s book and refuses to get up. Garfield thwarts a bank robbery.

st: Fit for a King/Ben Hog/Dessert in the Desert
d: Garfield tells the story of a King who is given his weight in gold every year./Orson dreams he's in Ben Hog's chariot race./Jon's car breaks down in the desert.
Jon, Garfield and Odie visit Cactus Jake./When Roy and Wade have a fight, Orson wonders what Hogcules would do./Garfield discovers a secret world inside a tree.
Garfield writes his own script for the show./The weasel convinces Roy to suggest an election./Jon visits his cousin Berferd.
Jon and Garfield hear the story of the dragon and the cat./Roy's Morning bugle keeps waking up an angry bear./Garfield's attempt at a beach romance are hindered.

st: Clean Sweep/Secrets of the Animated Cartoon/How the West was Lost
d: Jon gets an automatic dog washer./Orson gives a lecture on cartoon rules and logic./Garfield comes to the rescue when Cactus Jake is fired.
Jon gets to meet Vivacia, the TV horror show hostess of his dreams. Wade Duck is caught in a 60-minute style interview.
Garfield gets their mailman fired./Roy can't get enough of the latest crop of peanuts./Garfield dreams he's in ancient Egypt.
A fast-talking salesman cons Jon. CatTV airs the latest video, “That’s Called Bein’ A Cat.”
Garfield tells how it was the Wright brothers’ cat that first flew at Kitty Hawk.
Garfield becomes guilt ridden when he believes he has caused Jon to get rid of Odie./One of Orson's older brothers decides to turn honest./Jon thinks he's acting too much like Garfield.
Garfield and Penelope imagine what it would be like to be married.
Garfield's relative was the first cat to land on the moon./A rooster arrives from another farm./Garfield's fairy Godfather makes him an offer.

st: The Binky Show/U.S. Acres: Keeping Cool/Don't Move!
d: Garfield decides to win Jon a birthday present on a game show./When Orson's brothers come to torment him./Odie must remain outside a pet store.

st: Twice Told Tale/Orson Goes on Vacation/Wedding Bell Blues

st: Hound of the Arbuckles/Read Alert/Urban Arbuckle

st: Mistakes Will Happen/The Well Dweller/The Wise Man

Jon tries to sell Garfield as a cartoon series. The vegetables Wade is guarding disappear.
When Jon is set-up for humiliation by a dating game TV show, Garfield comes to the rescue.
